faq.q: What services does Carbon Stealth VCC offer?
faq.a: Carbon Stealth offers web development (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL), game development (FiveM, browser MMOs), embedded systems (PLC, Modbus, Eurotherm), DevOps (Docker, Nginx, Hetzner VPS), branding, and code rescue consulting.
Based in Bobov Dol, Bulgaria (EIK: BG208725180, address: ul. Samuil 3, 2670). Serving clients remotely across Europe and worldwide.

A medieval dark fantasy browser MMO built with React, Vite, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, and Docker. Features 52+ database models, 27 game pages, and real-time PvP combat.

faq.q: Does Carbon Stealth build FiveM resources?
faq.a: Yes. CS Anticheat v4.0 has 40+ detection modules including DMA behavioral scoring. Also: mechanic tablet systems, bank heist scripts, and racing resources. Multi-framework QBCore and ESX support.

faq.q: What embedded and IoT systems does Carbon Stealth work with?
faq.a: Eurotherm EPC3004 oven controllers via Modbus RTU/TCP, WAGO PFC200 PLCs with CODESYS, elevator control boards with 102 I/O points and 14-state state machines, Arduino/ESP32 IoT devices.
React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Nginx, Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, Socket.IO. Infrastructure: Hetzner VPS, Ubuntu 24.04, Let's Encrypt SSL.

services/ecommerce.noscriptHtml:
Professional E-Commerce

Carbon Stealth VCC develops professional online stores that actually sell. From artisan boutiques to multi-vendor marketplaces, we build fast, secure, conversion-optimized e-commerce sites integrated with Stripe, PayPal and major Italian and European couriers.

E-commerce platforms we use

We select the right platform for your business: WooCommerce for flexibility and full customization, Shopify for speed of launch and simplicity, or custom React + Stripe solutions for complex projects with unique business logic. Every choice is based on your real needs, not our technical preferences.

Benefici chiave

  • Complete payment integrationStripe, PayPal, bank transfer, cash on delivery. One-click checkout, saved payment methods, recurring subscription management, split payments for marketplaces.
  • Advanced catalog managementConfigurable products with unlimited variants, bundles, digital and physical goods, multi-location inventory, bulk CSV import/export, ERP sync.
  • Conversion optimizationOptimized 1-2 step checkout, abandoned cart recovery emails, intelligent upsells and cross-sells, social proof, customer reviews with Schema.org.
  • E-commerce specific SEOSchema.org Product, Offer, AggregateRating for every product. Rich snippets with price, availability and rating. Dedicated product XML sitemap for Google Shopping.

Do you offer maintenance after launch?

Yes. We offer monthly maintenance contracts from €29/month that include security updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring, continuous SEO optimization, monthly reports and priority technical support.

Will the site be optimized for Google and AI?

Absolutely. Every site includes complete technical SEO, rich Schema.org, XML sitemap, optimized meta tags, Core Web Vitals below Google targets, and llms.txt for AI. Tested with Google Rich Results Test and Lighthouse.

Can I manage content myself?

Yes. We implement a CMS (WordPress, Strapi, Sanity or custom dashboard) that allows you to modify text, images, pages and blog posts without touching code. We also provide brief video training.

Does the site work in multiple languages?

Yes. We support native multilingual architectures with hreflang, localized URLs (/en/, /bg/), and multilingual CMS. All our projects are available in Italian, English and Bulgarian.

What happens if the site grows and becomes slow?

We constantly monitor performance. If the site grows beyond current hosting capacity, we automatically scale to more powerful VPS or implement advanced CDN/caching. Included in maintenance plans.

Ready to start your project?

Contact us for a free quote within 24 hours. We analyze your needs and propose the best solution for your budget and goals.

Richiedi Preventivo
